episodes.synopsis: Minami Kyoya aspires to join SI-VIS, a music group. But he gets caught up in a mysterious force, Mirage.
episodes.title: City of Mirage

episodes.synopsis: Yosuke dies in the battle with the Mirage, and Kyoya is devastated. Soji tells him to go back to his hometown.
episodes.title: A Thoroughly Eaten Star

episodes.synopsis: Kyoya struggles to reach the other members’ level. When his debut stage is about to start, the Mirage appears.
episodes.title: Welcome to Hellish Paradise

episodes.synopsis: Despite everything, Kyoya leads a fulfilling school life. One day, Rui approaches Kyoya with a desperate plea.
episodes.title: New Team with a Rocky Road Ahead

episodes.synopsis: SI-VIS’s camp starts off awkward, but eventually, they start to open up. Then, Siren gives them a challenge.
episodes.title: The Day When Five Become One

episodes.synopsis: SI-VIS plans to counter the Mirage of unprecedented scale with the new album release concert.
episodes.title: Holding This Song and Courage in My Heart

episodes.synopsis: Kyoya invites Nagi to the school festival while on a date. Then, we learn about June’s little brother.
episodes.title: Irrational Encounter

episodes.synopsis: Kyoya, μ, and Soji compete for points at the festival. Moved by June's voice, Krios questions his actions.
episodes.title: Light and Darkness After the Festival

episodes.synopsis: The Mirage has appeared in Saegusa Academy! But learning the identity of XENOS, June is consumed with hatred.
episodes.title: I Want to See Your Gentle Smile Again

episodes.synopsis: Rui begins to train Nagi, but Kyoya is upset to learn that Nagi is slated to be a new SI-VIS member.
episodes.title: The Sixth SI-VIS

episodes.synopsis: SI-VIS goes to vacation on an island owned by Seina. There, Kyoya discovers texts that reminds him of Yosuke.
episodes.title: A Diva and a Knight

episodes.synopsis: The Mirage appears in Kyoya's hometown, and Lukos' attack drives SI-VIS into a corner.
episodes.title: The Last Remaining Despair

episodes.synopsis: SI-VIS starts to train during Siren’s absence. Meanwhile, a mysterious figures watch over from afar.
episodes.title: Dejection and Determination

episodes.synopsis: Soji visits Kyoya in his hometown to bring him back. Meanwhile, Krios is fueled to avenge Lukos.
episodes.title: Come Back to Life, My Friend

episodes.synopsis: The Mirage suddenly appears in Tokyo. Without Kyoya and Soji, SI-VIS counterattacks with a guerrilla concert.
episodes.title: Because I Am SI-VIS

episodes.synopsis: Kyoya tries to help Siren, and Nagi trains hard to step up. Then, a shocking secret is revealed in Harmonia.
episodes.title: Welcome to Labyrinth

episodes.synopsis: Nagi and μ are trapped in a mysterious labyrinth. Separated SI-VIS members fight hard for each other.
episodes.title: Wishes and Songs Will Be Heard

episodes.synopsis: The most formidable enemy of all, Apollo, and SI-VIS commence the battle that will determine their fate.
episodes.title: Bring Despair to the Earth, and…

episodes.synopsis: In the chaos, SI-VIS tries to regroup. Meanwhile, a major change is happening within XENOS.
episodes.title: Accelerating Collapse

episodes.synopsis: SI-VIS prepares to leave the Earth to take Nagi back. Meanwhile, Nagi learns about the diva.
episodes.title: Future After Revenge

episodes.synopsis: Samael challenges SI-VIS to a battle over Nagi and the multiple Mirages on the earth.
episodes.title: Strongest Because of Imperfection

episodes.synopsis: Apollo launches the final attack on the Earth using Nagi. Kyoya stands up to save her.
episodes.title: A Diva in the Cage

episodes.synopsis: SI-VIS faces Kokytos in the Mirage. With Siren back, the best performance in the history of SI-VIS begins!
episodes.title: Triumphant Return of a Super Star

episodes.synopsis: The live concert that determines the fate of Earth will proceed to its encore.
episodes.title: Grand Finale of the Beginning
